MORE:
1. Approved the Un-Audited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the Half Year ended 30th
September, 2026 pursuant to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure
Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

2. Took on record the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors on the Un-Audited
Financial Results for the Half Year ended 30th September, 2026.

3. Approved the Statement of Assets and Liabilities as on 30th September, 2026 and the Cash Flow
Statement for the Half Year ended 30th September, 2026.

4. Adopted the Declaration pursuant to Regulation 33(3) (d) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 regarding the Auditors' Report with unmodified opinion
on the Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company for the Half Year ended 30th September, 2026.
